title: OQOL
description: Minecraft with optimization and quality of life upgrades. Does not add any new content to the game.
body:
![Minecraft: Vanilla + OQOL](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab8ea0e35b792a2438c1858f4d492050af45c28c.png) > A minecraft modpack that adds optimization and quality of life changes to the vanilla experience. # What Does This Modpack Do? This modpack only adds optimization mods, graphics mods, and quality of life mods. The point of this modpack is to not change how the game plays, but just brings it into the modern era to allow it to run better on modern hardware and take out some tedious mechanics. This modpack does not add any new content to the game. # Why Use This Modpack? This modpack can be used to join any server or host a server that does not need its users to download their own mods. It can be standalone on Client or Server but has extra features if it is installed on both. Because of this, The game can be enjoyed by anyone playing the pack regardless of who has it installed. # What Does This Modpack Add?
